title: Cerebus Jaka’s Story 9 May #122 ISSN 0712-7774 Aardvark-Vanaheim - Dave Sim 1989
descriptionText:
This is a rare and collectible comic book titled "Cerebus Jaka’s Story 9 May #122" published by Aardvark-Vanaheim in 1989. The comic book features the work of acclaimed artists and writers Dave Sim and Gerhard. It belongs to the Copper Age (1984-1991) of US comics and is intended for a general audience.

The comic book is a single issue format and is in English language. It has a vintage look and feel, making it a great addition to any comic book collection. The story features the character Cerebus and is a great read for fans of US comics.
